description: This file defines the SNProtocolOperator003 class, a subclass of SNProtocolOperator002, implementing cryptographic key derivation and item key creation for protocol version V003 in a secure encryption system.

classes.name: SNProtocolOperator003
classes.description: A subclass of SNProtocolOperator002 implementing protocol version V003, including methods for generating item keys, deriving root keys, and creating root keys with specific parameters.

methods.name: generateNewItemsKeyContent
methods.description: Generates new item key content with cryptographically secure random keys and version info.

methods.name: createItemsKey
methods.description: Creates a new encrypted items key payload for item encryption.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Derives a root key asynchronously from a password and key parameters.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Derives a cryptographic key using PBKDF2 with salt generated from key parameters.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a new root key with specified identifier, password, and origination.

methods.name: generateSalt
methods.description: Generates a salt value for key derivation using SHA-256 hash of combined parameters.
